input.quote: 11.1 Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
input.rationale: Section 11.1 is walk-away territory: it requires immediate cessation of all assistance and permanent deletion of Customer Data with no export or migration support, so there is no transition assistance period at all (not even the 90-day fallback). It also contradicts Sections 11.2 (30-day return in a machine-readable format) and 11.3 (deletion only after confirmed return, with officer certification), and the "agreed transition period" contemplated by Section 10.1. Sections 11.2-11.3 already satisfy the preferred data-return and certified-deletion elements, so the minimal fix is to replace 11.1 with up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates and subordinate deletion to 11.2-11.3.

proposal.summary: Replace immediate-deletion/no-assistance clause in 11.1 with up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, aligned with the data return and deletion mechanics in 11.2-11.3.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We replaced the immediate cessation of assistance and deletion of Customer Data with up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, which our playbook requires and which is also needed for the export and certified-deletion mechanics in Sections 11.2 and 11.3 and the transition period referenced in Section 10.1 to work. If six months is difficult, we can accept ninety days.

ops.oldText: Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
ops.newText: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or an Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance, including export and migration support, for up to six months after the effective date of expiry or termination at Vendor's then-current rates. Vendor shall not delete Customer Data except in accordance with Sections 11.2 and 11.3.
